mapper.delete: delete from t_wiring_config where wiring_config_id = #{wiringConfigId, jdbcType=BIGINT}
delete from t_wiring_config where wiring_diagram_id = #{wiringDiagramId, jdbcType=INTEGER}

update.foreach:
update t_wiring_config a a.wiring_diagram_id = #{TWiringConfig.wiringDiagramId}, a.equipment_id = #{TWiringConfig.equipmentId}, a.equipment_name = #{TWiringConfig.equipmentName}, a.equipment_type = #{TWiringConfig.equipmentType}, a.x_coordinate = #{TWiringConfig.xCoordinate}, a.y_coordinate = #{TWiringConfig.yCoordinate}, a.update_time = #{TWiringConfig.updateTime}, a.update_person = #{TWiringConfig.updatePerson},
where a.wiring_config_id = #{TWiringConfig.wiringConfigId, jdbcType=BIGINT}

mapper.select: select a.wiring_config_id, a.wiring_diagram_id, a.equipment_id, a.equipment_name, a.equipment_type, a.x_coordinate, a.y_coordinate, a.update_time, a.update_person from t_wiring_config a where 1 = 1 and a.wiring_config_id = #{wiringConfigId, jdbcType=BIGINT} limit 1

select a.wiring_config_id, a.wiring_diagram_id, a.equipment_id, a.equipment_name, a.equipment_type, a.x_coordinate, a.y_coordinate, a.update_time, a.update_person, if(d.camera_id is NULL, 0, 1) as is_exist from t_wiring_config a left join t_wiring_diagram b on a.wiring_diagram_id = b.wiring_diagram_id LEFT JOIN t_camera_info d on a.equipment_id = d.camera_id where 1 = 1 and b.region_id = #{regionId, jdbcType=BIGINT}
